reason: The existing mapping to Article 10(2) of the DORA Delegated Regulation is defensible and complete. The evidence, specifically the text of Article 10(2) and its sub-point (b), explicitly requires financial entities to perform automated vulnerability scanning and assessments on ICT assets supporting critical or important functions on at least a weekly basis, which directly corresponds to the control objective.
